theme: A quiet Adriatic pause before the long trip home.
greeting: Last day of the crossing, Dan — you're off the boat and back on land in Cavtat. Today is calm; tomorrow is the marathon home to Tampa, so the real work today is getting ahead of it.

needsAttention.title: Lock the dawn checkout and airport taxi
needsAttention.detail: LH4297 leaves Dubrovnik at 7:30, which means a ~5:15 AM taxi and a night or express checkout from the Remisens. Confirm both with the property today while you still have signal — your Cavtat task flags these as land-only jobs.

needsAttention.title: Book the Tampa SUV before you land
needsAttention.detail: You touch down at TPA at 3:55 tomorrow with no car booked. The Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV is a p1 marked don't-arrive-without-it — a jet-lagged Sunday walk-up is exactly what it's meant to avoid.

needsAttention.title: Cover the St Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20–21 still has no room before the Orlando villa opens on the 22nd. It's a standing p1 and you land tomorrow — today is the last easy moment to book it.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out early, and there's no six-seater in Maine once the Pathfinder heads south. A refundable hold costs nothing and has been sitting since the 14th.

flagged.title: LinkedIn: VP Government Affairs roles
flagged.detail: A new-jobs alert built off VP, Government Affairs at Macy's — on-target for your public-affairs and board search. Worth a scan once you're home.

flagged.title: New Equifax report and score
flagged.detail: Your updated credit report and score are available — routine, no action unless something looks off.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promotions — NYT Cooking, market digests, furniture and garden shops, language-app deals.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on a reply from you.

recipe.title: Vin santo–roasted pears
recipe.why: Autumn pears are at their peak now, and a slow roast in sweet wine is the season's easiest luxury.

tasks.title: Sort the Disney tickets for the 26th–27th

acts.line: The charter is over and you're back on land in Cavtat — a slow morning by the Adriatic before the long haul home.
Nothing on the calendar; the sea-view room is yours right up until the early start.
Pack tonight and turn in early — the taxi comes around 5:15 for a 7:30 flight out of Dubrovnik.
